photos.c: Winning South of Thames Senior SONNING,BERKS -1951
P. NEWELL hands over to C. WALKER after doing 5th fastest time on stage 3.
BOTTOM LEFT Our winning team in the Mitcham '15' - (left to right) Barry Sawyer, 5th, Bill Kerr, 8th, and Chas. Walker 7th.

HEY!------WHAT'S THAT?-----'OUR CHAS' TAKING A PEP PILL? Eddie Lacey's action picture seems to catch Charlie Walker in the act during the Club '7' with 2½ miles to go. He certainly needed it, for Gerry North (no pill) passed him shortly after to win by over a minute.

BOTTOM LEFT:Charlie Walker leads Dick Jones of Portsmouth with Stephenson (Ponders End) and M. Palmer (St. Albans) just behind. Walker was forced to retire a little after this and his opponents here went on to finish 69th, 89th and 117th respectively.
Photos (full page montage; captions on page 12)
CENTRE: Charlie Walker seeks refreshment in the Polytechnic water jump after a brilliant first marathon in 2:33:07.

From left to right, Norman Stairs, Barry Sawyer, Alan Bishop, Len Bishop, John Moore, Charlie Walker, Denis Jones, and Derek Crookes. This picture was taken at Windsor Castle just before they were sent on their way by Her Majesty The Queen.
Trevor Hart hands over to Charlie Walker with Weatherill (Portsmouth) waiting to take over from the fast-finishing Tulloh.
LEFT: Hart leads Fairclough in the chase for O'Hara. RIGHT: Bill Kerr paces "World Sports" star Charlie Walker!

Above: Chas (18) tears into the lead on the first lap of a Club Championship 880 yards Race at Battersea Park. We are not absolutely certain of the year but it was probably 1955, one of the years when Charlie Walker, (4) at the back of the pack became Club Champion over the distance. Behind Charlie Manning can be seen a youthful Jim Heathfield. Can anyone put names to the other faces in the picture?
